item.tib: sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa
item.skt: Sha Dang+ga yo ga TI kA
item.coloph: sbyor ba yan lag drug pa'i 'grel pa paN+Di ta chen po nyi ma dpal ye shes kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /rgya gar shar phyogs kyi paN+Di ta chen po shrAM bi b+hu ti tsan+d+rasa ru lag gi snying po 'breng mtshams kyi sa'i cha/ dpal rgya rtags kyi gtsugs khang du bsgyur ba'o
